name: wariba-platform
description: WARIBA — infrastructure de progression pour traders disciplinés (Afrique francophone).

scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:rls && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:fast: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm boundaries:check && pnpm secrets:scan && pnpm test:unit
scripts.test:integration:smoke: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- sh -c 'pnpm --filter @wariba/database test:integration:smoke && pnpm --filter @wariba/application test:integration && pnpm --filter @wariba/worker test:integration'
scripts.test:integration:full: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- sh -c 'pnpm --filter @wariba/database test:integration:full && pnpm --filter @wariba/application test:integration && pnpm --filter @wariba/worker test:integration'
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- sh -c 'pnpm --filter @wariba/realtime test:e2e:smoke && pnpm --filter @wariba/web test:e2e:smoke'
scripts.test:e2e:auth: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/web test:e2e:auth
scripts.test:e2e:trade: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/web test:e2e:trade
scripts.test:e2e:pending: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/realtime test:e2e:pending
scripts.test:e2e:payout: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/web test:e2e:payout
scripts.test:e2e:control: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/web test:e2e:control
scripts.test:e2e:mobile: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/web test:e2e:mobile
scripts.test:e2e:full: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- sh -c 'pnpm --filter @wariba/realtime test:e2e:full && pnpm --filter @wariba/web test:e2e:full'
scripts.test:rls:smoke: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/database test:rls:smoke
scripts.test:rls:full: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/database test:rls:full
scripts.test:recovery: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/realtime test:recovery
scripts.test:failover: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm --filter @wariba/realtime test:failover
scripts.test:load: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- node scripts/run-realtime-load.mjs
scripts.test:certification: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:property && pnpm build && pnpm db:test && pnpm test:integration:full && pnpm test:rls:full && pnpm test:e2e:full && pnpm test:recovery && pnpm test:failover && pnpm test:load
scripts.db:test: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL -- sh -c 'supabase test db --db-url "$DATABASE_URL"'
scripts.ci: pnpm test:fast && pnpm build && pnpm db:test && pnpm test:integration:smoke && pnpm test:rls:smoke && pnpm test:e2e:smoke
